title: Business Texting for HubSpot — Jon Martin
seoTitle: Business Texting Tools That Work With HubSpot
description: Salesmsg, Aircall, and Calilio compared for small teams that text customers from HubSpot: prices, what gets logged, workflow triggers, and calling.
h1: Business texting that works with HubSpot
dek: Three tools that let a small team send and receive business texts and keep every message on the HubSpot record, so nobody texts a customer from a personal phone again.
Prices and features below come from each vendor's own pages, checked on the date shown.

blocks.html: This is for a small sales or service team, often three to ten people, whose customers answer texts faster than email, and who keep contacts and deals in HubSpot.
The problem these tools solve is simple: texts sent from personal phones never reach the CRM, so the next person to pick up the account has no idea what was said.

Pick Salesmsg if most of the work is texting, and you want HubSpot workflows to send texts on their own. Pick Aircall if the team mostly makes calls and texting is a side channel. Pick Calilio if you want calls and texts on HubSpot timelines and the per-user price matters most.

Salesmsg Basic with one extra seat comes to about $35 a month. For a three-person team, the rough monthly floor is about $36 on Calilio Standard billed annually, and about $90 on Aircall Essentials billed annually.

Salesmsg Basic is $25 a month on monthly billing, with 1 seat and 1 number included. Pro is $277 a month on monthly billing. Extra seats are $10 a month each, and extra numbers are $5 a month each. Usage runs on credits: 1 credit per SMS (160 characters) and 1 credit per minute of calling. There's a 14-day free trial and a 30-day money-back guarantee.

Its HubSpot integration offers two-way contact and activity sync, texting from inside HubSpot, and SMS triggered from HubSpot workflows. It also says SMS opt-outs update the HubSpot contact property, which matters for keeping texting legal when contacts reply STOP.

Aircall Essentials is $30 per license per month, billed annually, and Professional is $50 per license per month. There is a minimum of 3 licenses on Essentials and Professional, and you get 25% off for paying annually.

Aircall logs calls and SMS to HubSpot Contacts, Companies, Deals, and Tickets, with recordings, comments, outcomes, and transcription. Its Insight Cards show HubSpot history before a rep answers. Texting is part of the phone system, not the center of it, so check SMS limits for your country before you commit.

Calilio Standard is $12 per user per month billed annually, or $15 billed monthly. Premium is $28 per user per month billed annually, or $35 billed monthly. Note that Standard caps out at 10 users; Premium has no user limit. There's a 14-day money-back guarantee.

Per Calilio, the HubSpot integration is on both Standard and Premium, and every call, text, and voicemail lands on the right HubSpot contact timeline, with recordings, AI summaries, and transcripts. Calilio lists 16 events synced to HubSpot. One caution: the HubSpot integration went live in September 2026, so it has a shorter track record than the other two.

Start with which channel carries the work. If the team texts all day, a texting-first tool with workflow triggers saves the most time. If the team is on the phone all day, buy the phone system and use its texting.
Then count seats honestly. A minimum license count or a per-seat add-on changes the math more than the headline price does for a team this size.
Finally, check the compliance basics: who registers your numbers for business texting, how opt-outs reach HubSpot, and whether texts to some countries cost extra.
Clean phone number fields first. Texting tools match conversations to contacts by number, so a mix of formats creates duplicate contacts on day one.
Agree on one property that marks a contact as opted out of texts, and make sure the tool you pick writes to it.
